question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

A stick in the mud
solution: The correct answer is: **A person who resists change**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"A stick in the mud"** refers to a person who is resistant to change and is often seen as boring or old-fashioned. (परिवर्तन का विरोध करने वाला व्यक्ति) • **Example:** He is such a stick in the mud; he never wants to try anything new. • **"A person who resists change"** describes someone who is not open to new ideas or ways of doing things, preferring to stick to traditional or familiar methods. (परिवर्तन का विरोध करने वाला व्यक्ति) • **Example:** Despite the benefits of the new system, he remains a person who resists change. Therefore, the correct answer is: **A person who resists change**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **A person with no character** (कोई चरित्र नहीं रखने वाला व्यक्ति): Someone who lacks moral or ethical principles. • **Example:** He is considered a person with no character because of his dishonest actions. • **A person without any fear** (बिना किसी डर के व्यक्ति): Someone who is brave and courageous. • **Example:** She is a person without any fear, always ready to take on challenges. • **A generous person** (उदार व्यक्ति): Someone who is willing to give more of something, especially money or time, than is usual or expected. • **Example:** He is known as a generous person who donates to charity regularly. 2f:T9cc, The correct answer is: **Behind closed doors**.
